title: snack data purge payload
description: The `data` of a `snack data purge --json` document. A dry run reports what it would delete under the same shape as a real one, so the preview and the deletion cannot describe different things. Frozen at 0.9: a field here does not disappear or change meaning without a major release, and a consumer must tolerate fields added by a later minor.

scope.description: What was selected. A half-open window: `since` is included, `until` is not.

cursor_reset.description: Ingestion cursors moved back, so the deleted window is not silently re-read.

tombstones.description: Records refused on a later synchronization, written only for --prevent-reimport.
